reviews.text:
Matt Toney designed our pool and somehow in 5 questions with a set of survey tools, captured exactly what we were looking for.  After multiple proposals from other builders lasting hours, it was refreshing to work with Matt.

Francisco was our project manager and his crews are timely and clean.  We were impressed with their efficiency, follow through and how polite and considerate they were.  Francisco communicates clearly with a lot of positivity and detail.  They actually beat their timeline as well so I cant say enough good about the whole experience throughout the entire build process.
reviews.author: Brian Bules

reviews.text: My wife and I are very happy with how our pool turned out! Victor did a fantastic job with the design, and Bert was a fantastic project manager. The construction process wasn’t too bad, and we always had open lines of communication with the Team. We did have one issue with the excavation cost coming in higher than expected, but this was resolved after discussion with Riverbend. Tom also did a great job with pool school. We love our pool and can’t wait to use it for years to come!
reviews.author: tyler mcallister

reviews.text:
We started the process of building a pool in Dec '24.  The Liberty HOA was very responsive and quickly approved Victor's plan/concept (pending city approval).  Of course, with the pending holiday season, the city didn't complete the approval process until Jan.  Once the city approved, the HOA quickly issued final approval.
We met with Francisco and Victor following the approvals and they went over the process - and what they could and couldn't promise as weather gets (and did have) a vote on the completion timeline.
The 'dig' team - in fact all teams - were very professional and courteous of the need to move vehicles for both us and the neighbors to allow people to go about their daily business.
I don't believe we ever had an inspection failed and passed first pass.  In fact, the only time I knew the project was being inspected was the final as the inspector had to hear the alarm sound.
Was there a couple of supply chain issues, yes (what industry didn't have a supply chain hiccup or two starting in Feb '25?).  Victor and Francisco pretty much kept us in the loop.  One of the hiccups was the second hand rail (missing in the picture below).  Victor followed up and the second hand rail arrived about 2 weeks later.
I could have probably had the landscaping done for a bit less, but, I chose to let Riverbend sub-contract it as the quality of work was excellent.  The 'Putting Green' team was especially great!
We finished in late Apr '25 and by late May '25 we could heat the pool.  Had the 1st family party the 1st weekend of June.
Like any construction project expect a few delays (weather, shipping, competing labor requirements, etc . . .) so build that into your personal timeline.
I recommend Riverbend, Victor and Francisco to build your future pool.
reviews.author: Mike Lunday

reviews.text: I’ll start off by saying maybe my expectations are just too high in general, but Riverbend was really sold to us as a high end pool builder. We spent a not insignificant amount of money to less then 3 years later have replaced a pump, the paved deck is completely sloping and part of the paved deck needs to be completely replaced. Oh and our iron gate has never seated properly since being rehung. I’m also convinced the pebble tec color they used is not what we picked. Someone came and looked at issues but never followed up with a remedy and of course nothing is covered by warranty any longer. There are also design things they talked us out of that they did for other people in our neighborhood. We definitely have buyers remorse and wish we had gone another direction with our backyard.
reviews.author: Morgan Lang

reviews.text:
James Guice went the “extra mile” to ensure my pool timer, freeze guard, and wiring problems were repaired quickly.  It extremely rare to find an individual who cares about their customer’s problems/concerns to the degree that James does.

The other pool company I used left me with a complete mess, pool was not running, wiring was in disarray.  James help (and patience) in securing the right expertise to solve the problem was greatly appreciated.

Riverbend should be proud of James commitment to “outstanding customer service”  that will definitely make me a loyal customer for years to come.
reviews.author: Fred236

reviews.text:
Yay, it’s done—and we’ve been loving every minute in our new pool and spa!

We are absolutely thrilled with the design and craftsmanship of our pool built by Riverbend Sandler. From our first site consult to final walkthrough, Victor Ramirez was with us every step of the way. Salespeople often disappear after the deal is signed, but not Victor—he was professional, creative, and most importantly, ethical throughout the entire process.

Building over the winter brought its challenges, but our project manager Francisco navigated rain, snow, and freezing temperatures like a pro.

We couldn’t be happier with how the pool integrates into our property—it truly feels like it was meant to be here. Now that the sod and turf have filled in, we’ve breathed a huge sigh of relief and are soaking up every moment with our family.

Looking forward to many years of memories in our backyard oasis!
reviews.author: J Thompson

reviews.text: Riverbend Sandler built my pool twenty-two years ago.  The pool has held up very well, but the plaster finish needed to be replaced, way beyond life expectancy.  I struck a deal with Christian Williams at Riverbend Sandler for a complete pool remodel, including a spectacular new light blue pebble plaster finish.  This work is now complete.  We had a few scheduling glitches, but my experience on past projects has been that scheduling issues are what happens in construction.  More important, the price was fair.  Most important, the quality of the work seems to be very good.  Pool looks fantastic,  I am a happy customer, and I recommend these folks.
reviews.author: Larry Carlson

reviews.text: We were having an issue with our pool water fountain not working, and Jonathan Lara from Riverbend Sandler Pools came out to clean our pool filter. I was truly impressed with his work. He was very kind, professional, and took the time to explain everything clearly and answer all of my questions in detail. It’s rare these days to find a technician who is this thorough and knowledgeable. He did an excellent job, and the service was more than I could have asked for.
reviews.author: Charles
